rules: Overlines/Badges must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em])
Body text minimum 16px for comfortable mobile reading
Hierarchy must rely on font weight and size, not color

layout_and_grids.desktop_container: max-w-[420px] mx-auto h-screen border-x border-border shadow-2xl relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col bg-background
layout_and_grids.bottom_nav: h-16 border-t border-border flex justify-around items-center bg-background absolute bottom-0 w-full z-40
layout_and_grids.cards: border border-border rounded-xl p-4 bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm flex flex-col gap-3
layout_and_grids.spacing: Use tight, dense spacing for cards (gap-2, gap-3) to allow scanning. Generous padding (p-4) around main sections.

components.station_status_card: Must display: availability status, queue range, estimated wait time, gas pressure (bar), last-updated freshness, confidence level. Use flat layouts without heavy cards where possible.
components.badges: Flat colors, no gradients. Use bg-opacity-15 for background and solid color for text. e.g., bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800. Dark mode: bg-emerald-900/30 text-emerald-400.
components.bottom_sheet: Use Shadcn Drawer for 'Notify Me' alert builder and Navigation provider chooser. Must snap to bottom with a drag handle.
components.list_map_toggle: Pill-shaped segmented control fixed near the bottom or top of the screen.
components.notify_me_builder: Slider for queue/wait threshold, toggle for CNG availability, select for min pressure. Must use Shadcn form components customized to feel native.
components.data_freshness_indicators: Small pulsating dot for LIVE, static dot for others. Text sizes text-xs font-medium.
components.navigation_bottom_sheet: Grid of map providers (Google Maps, Waze, Apple Maps) for quick routing.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Extremely minimal. shadow-sm for cards. shadow-lg for bottom sheets and modals only.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid. Light mode: border-gray-200. Dark mode: border-gray-800. Sharp or subtly rounded (rounded-lg or rounded-xl maximum).
visual_enhancers.animations: Subtle slide-up for bottom sheets. Fast opacity transitions. No bouncy/springy animations. Must respect prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.page_transitions: None or extremely fast opacity fade (duration-150).
motion.micro_interactions: Tap states on cards and buttons must lower opacity slightly (active:opacity-80) or change background color (hover:bg-accent).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1. Primary button text must be readable against the primary color.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all buttons, nav items, list items, and interactive elements.
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='bottom-nav-home').

image_urls.description: White electric car charging station with lush green wall (Use for generic eco-friendly station hero or landing page)
Gasoline station during night time (Use for station details fallback image or dark mode)
Grey concrete empty road (Use for Empty States like 'No stations nearby', 'No active alerts', or 'Saved list empty')

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Keep stroke-width at 1.5 or 2 for clarity on mobile screens.

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST build this strictly as a Mobile-First PWA UI. On desktop, wrap the entire app in a max-width 420px centered container (like a mobile simulator) with a border and shadow.
Use Tailwind CSS and Shadcn/UI for all styling and components.
Implement a 'Light, clean, minimal' design. Avoid excessive gradients, glassmorphism, or heavy shadows. Prioritize speed and trust.
Create a Bottom Navigation bar for the mobile shell (Home / Map / Alerts / Saved / Profile).
Use the Shadcn Drawer component extensively for bottom sheets (e.g., Notify Me alert builder, Navigation provider chooser).
Implement distinct Status Badges (AVAILABLE, LOW_SUPPLY, INTERRUPTED, UNAVAILABLE, UNKNOWN) and Data Freshness indicators (LIVE, RECENT, AGING, STALE).
Ensure dark mode is supported (toggled via a theme provider), keeping the high-contrast, minimal aesthetic.
The 'Notify Me' alert builder is the MOST IMPORTANT feature. Make it accessible, intuitive, and prominent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts for text unless it is a hero section or empty state.
Do not apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Apply transitions explicitly.
Do not use placeholder image URLs (like via.placeholder.com). ONLY use the ones provided in `media.image_urls`.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements for testing.
Ensure the UI uses high-contrast colors to evoke trust and high scannability.
Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometrical alignment.
